title: PROGRAF (tacrolimus) approved prescribing information
status: current approved labeling; version must be checked at use
limitations: Prograf-specific labeling; not proof of bioequivalence or clinical interchangeability for every generic or formulation.

title: FDA therapeutic-equivalence update for a specific Accord tacrolimus capsule product
supports: product-specific concern that trough similarity may not fully characterize peak exposure
limitations: Must not be generalized to all strengths, manufacturers, formulations, or tacrolimus generic products. Exact study design and PK statistics must be reproduced from the official record before quantitative claims.

title: CPIC Guideline for CYP3A5 Genotype and Tacrolimus Dosing
status: published guideline; current update status must be checked at use
citation: Birdwell KA, et al. Clin Pharmacol Ther. 2015;98(1):19-24. doi:10.1002/cpt.113.
limitations: Starting-dose guidance is not a replacement for TDM and does not validate a specific AI/PopPK model, transplant population, or interacting-drug scenario.

title: Local assay-method comparison required for immunoassay-to-LC-MS/MS transition
status: not supplied in the current flagship case
limitations: Public literature cannot substitute for the laboratory's paired-sample bias, commutability, decision-limit reclassification, and matrix-interference study.

title: MOUNJARO (tirzepatide) approved prescribing information
status: current approved labeling; version must be checked at use
limitations: The label is product-specific. It does not establish the human risk for every dual/triple agonist and does not provide all raw incidence tables or exact p-values.

title: LY3298176, a novel dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist: discovery to clinical proof of concept
citation: Coskun T, et al. Mol Metab. 2018;18:3-14. doi:10.1016/j.molmet.2018.09.009.
limitations: Directly supports tirzepatide pharmacology, not comparability or safety bridging for a different dual/triple agonist.

title: Tirzepatide as an imbalanced and biased dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist
citation: Willard FS, et al. JCI Insight. 2020;5(17):e140532. doi:10.1172/jci.insight.140532.
supports: tirzepatide-specific receptor pharmacology and signaling bias
limitations: Mechanistic distinction supports caution against class-wide extrapolation; it does not directly quantify human toxicity risk.

title: Emerging analytical report concerning tirzepatide and vitamin B12 co-formulation
organization: Source metadata incomplete in v0.9.0 case library
status: insufficiently documented for independent claim verification
supports: hypothesis that an uncharacterized additional species may occur under some co-formulation conditions
limitations: Article title/DOI, sample provenance, number of products/lots, validated method, structural confirmation, reference standard, quantitative exposure, independent replication, and conflict-of-interest details are not fully captured. Must not be described as a confirmed clinical-risk impurity.

title: Nonclinical Safety Assessment of Oligonucleotide-Based Therapeutics
status: draft; nonbinding; verify current status at use
supports: questions concerning sequence, chemistry, species relevance, exposure, class and off-target effects
limitations: Does not approve a product, define NORA R0-R5 roles, or justify animal-study reduction by itself.

title: ICH Safety Guideline topic S13: Nonclinical Safety Studies for Oligonucleotide-Based Therapeutics
status: topic status and regional implementation must be checked at the time of use
supports: harmonized topic context for oligonucleotide nonclinical safety
limitations: Do not state that S13 is final or implemented in a jurisdiction without point-in-time confirmation.

title: LY2181308 preclinical survivin inhibition study
status: published; exact citation must be linked in the case record
supports: preclinical survivin knockdown, apoptosis, and xenograft activity for LY2181308
limitations: LY2181308-specific chemistry, sequence, exposure, models, and regimen; indirect for a new BIRC5 ASO.

title: First-in-human LY2181308 pharmacodynamic and tumor-distribution study
status: published; exact evaluable-biopsy denominator must be captured
supports: tumor exposure and exploratory survivin mRNA/protein reduction in evaluable paired biopsies
limitations: Small evaluable subset, exploratory biopsy endpoints, assay variability, and no validated knockdown threshold for clinical benefit. The approximate 20% reduction must not be presented as population-wide or sufficient target engagement.

title: Randomized phase II LY2181308 plus docetaxel/prednisone in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer
supports: no demonstrated improvement in the reported efficacy endpoints
limitations: The negative trial does not by itself distinguish target invalidity from insufficient tumor exposure, knockdown depth/duration, patient selection, schedule, or combination strategy. Exact HR, 95% CI, p-value and analysis population must be copied from the paper into the claim record.

title: Japanese phase I LY2181308 study
supports: a reported reversible grade 3 liver-enzyme dose-limiting toxicity at the 750 mg dose in that study
limitations: Small early-phase cohort and LY2181308-specific regimen. Does not establish a class effect for all BIRC5 ASOs or all oligonucleotides.
